citation: Witte, Wise, Huys & Schulz (2024) — Worried exploration: Anxiety, depression, and exploration under threat

source.note: Adapted to jsPsych v8 from Witte et al.'s vanilla-JS/jQuery implementation. Reward grids (assets/sample_grid.json) are reused verbatim from the original repository (30 GP-sampled environments on an 11x11 grid, integer values 0-100). The original paradigm includes a battery of trait questionnaires and a bonus judgment-of-uncertainty round; this v1 port retains only the core 11-block grid-bandit paradigm.

description: Click tiles on an 11x11 grid to harvest fish. Rewards are spatially correlated. Half the blocks include a Kraken that punishes any click below the threshold (z<=50) by zeroing the block's earnings; the other half are safe. Tests value-directed exploitation, spatial generalization, and risk-sensitive exploration.
